title: Lab Assistant / Data Entry Operator, Project Research Scientist and More
organization: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Gorakhpur
age_limit: Not exceeding 35 years for Scientist 'B' and 28 years for Laboratory Technician
summary: AIIMS Gorakhpur invites eligible candidates for walk-in interviews to fill contractual positions under the Multi-Disciplinary Research Unit. Positions include Project Research Scientists, Technical Support, and Lab Assistant / Data Entry Operator. The walk-in interview is scheduled for December 8, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Project Research Scientist-II: Postgraduate degree with 3 years experience or Ph.D.
Project Research Scientist-I: First-class postgraduate degree in relevant disciplines or second-class with Ph.D.
Project Technical Support-II: B.Sc.-MLT / M.Sc.-MLT / M.Sc.-DMLT with 1 year research experience.
Lab Assistant / Data Entry Operator: First-class Graduate degree in science with computer knowledge and typing speed of 8,000 key depressions per hour.
how_to_apply_steps: Ensure eligibility requirements are met for the desired post.
Fill out the application form with required details.
Attend the walk-in interview on 08 December 2026 at the Administration Building, MRU AIIMS, Gorakhpur.
Bring original academic and professional documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies for verification.
